script_text: Buckle up, Aries — Mars enters your 12th House this week, and silence will speak louder than action. Monday and Tuesday drag as the Moon sextiles Saturn in your 6th House, demanding patience with routines before the 23rd. But by midweek, the Sun conjoins Jupiter in your 2nd House of Income — a rare transit signaling a career opportunity that could double your earnings if you claim it boldly. Thursday shifts everything when Venus trines Neptune in your 7th House of Partnerships, pulling a former connection back into your orbit through a dreamlike encounter. Your late-week power comes Sunday when Mars opposes Pluto, igniting a quiet confrontation you must face head-on to reclaim your authority. Wednesday is your power day because Venus enters your 5th House of Romance, sparking a creative collaboration that feels fated. Follow for daily updates.
